snippet.title: Rally Mechanic Simulator Trailer | Official PS5 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🏁 Master the art of rally mechanics! https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018074

Rally Car Mechanic Simulator races onto PlayStation 5 on July 7, 2026!

Get under the hood as a rally mechanic and prepare cars for the toughest stages. Diagnose damage, replace worn parts, and fine-tune everything from threaded suspension and gearboxes to turbos and race-grade transmissions. Manage your garage, grow your team, and turn a humble workshop into a championship-winning crew. Push every build to the limit with track testing before the next rally.

#RallyCarMechanicSimulator #PS5 #PlayStation #Simulator #CarGames #Rally #CarMechanic #Gaming #IndieGame #SimGames #WRC #SimulationGame #Tuning #Mechanic #RacingGames
